opening: can you clean up the volunteer roster spreadsheet? theres a bunch of duplicate people and the phone column is a mess of formats
reply: I merged the duplicate rows in the volunteer roster, matching on name plus email, which took the sheet from 412 rows down to 367. Where two copies disagreed I kept the more recent entry and listed the 9 conflicts on a new Review tab. The phone column now uses one format throughout, and the 14 numbers that were too short to be real are highlighted so you can check them.
title: Volunteer roster spreadsheet cleanup

opening: my flask app throws a 500 on the /reports page but nothing shows up in the logs. can you look at the repo and figure out why
reply: The 500 comes from the reports view calling strftime on a None value when a report has no end date. Errors weren't reaching your log because the app's logger was set up after Flask had already installed its default handler, so I moved the logging config above app creation. I also guarded the date formatting so open-ended reports show 'ongoing', and added a test that loads /reports with one of those rows.
title: Reports page 500 error

opening: help me plan a raised vegetable bed, 4 by 8, i want tomatoes peppers and some lettuce. zone 6
reply: Here's a layout for the 4x8 bed. The two tomato plants go on the north end so they don't shade everything else, with four pepper plants in front of them and lettuce in the southern third, where it gets some afternoon shade from the peppers by midsummer. I've added a planting calendar based on a May 10 last frost: start the peppers indoors in mid March, tomatoes in early April, and sow the lettuce directly in late April with a second round in August.
title: Raised vegetable bed plan

opening: we just adopted a 9 week old puppy and need a house training schedule that works around a 9 to 5
reply: I put together a weekday schedule for the puppy: out right after waking, after each meal, after naps, and every two hours while you're home. For the stretch while you're at work, the plan assumes a midday visit, because a 9 week old can't hold it for eight hours. The weekend version moves her to a three hour gap by week 12. I also added a short log sheet so you can track accidents and spot the times of day that need an extra trip out.
title: Puppy house training schedule

opening: i have 4 exams in two weeks, organic chem, stats, history and spanish. make me a study schedule that isnt insane
reply: The schedule covers the 14 days before your first exam. Organic chem gets the most time because it's first and you rated it hardest, so it takes the morning block on 8 of the days. Stats and Spanish trade afternoons, and history shows up in shorter review sessions until the final four days, when it gets full blocks. Every day stops by 9pm and keeps one hour free, and Sunday the 12th is a light day.
title: Two week exam study schedule

opening: write me a cover letter for this operations analyst posting, im coming from 6 years in retail management
reply: I drafted the cover letter around three things the posting asks for: inventory forecasting, process documentation, and working with cross-functional teams. Each paragraph ties one of them to something from your retail years, like the scheduling change that cut overtime by 18 percent. I kept it to 310 words. Two spots are marked where I guessed at numbers, so swap in the real figures before you send it.
title: Operations analyst cover letter

Every session starts with a five minute brisk walk, the run intervals build a little more slowly in weeks three and four, and each week has an optional repeat if a session felt rough. I also added two short strength sessions a week with exercises that support the knee, plus notes on picking softer routes like a track or packed trail.
title: Couch to 5k plan

opening: i need a simple monthly budget, i get paid twice a month and keep running short before the second check
reply: I set up the budget as two half-month columns that line up with your paychecks. Rent and the car payment both come out of the first check, which explains why money runs short around the 25th. Moving the phone bill and the gym membership to the second check balances the two halves to within 60 dollars of each other. The sheet also has a small buffer line that grows by 50 dollars each period.
title: Twice monthly budget setup

opening: our cat started peeing outside the litter box this week. what could be causing it
reply: Since this started suddenly, the first thing to rule out is a urinary problem, so I'd call the vet this week, especially if she's going more often or straining. Beyond that, the likely causes from what you described are the new litter brand you switched to on Monday and the box's move to the laundry room. I wrote up a step by step plan: go back to the old litter, add a second box in the old spot, and clean the problem areas with an enzyme cleaner.
title: Cat avoiding litter box

opening: set up a github actions workflow so pytest runs on every pull request for my repo
reply: I added .github/workflows/tests.yml, which runs pytest on every pull request and every push to main, on Python 3.11 and 3.12. It caches pip dependencies keyed on requirements.txt, so repeat runs take about 40 seconds instead of two minutes. I pushed it to a branch and opened a test PR, and both jobs passed. If you want failing tests to block merging, turn on the required check in the branch protection settings.
title: Pytest GitHub Actions workflow

opening: help me write a lesson plan teaching equivalent fractions to 4th graders, 45 minutes
reply: The lesson plan runs 45 minutes. It opens with a 5 minute warm up folding paper strips, moves to 15 minutes of guided practice on a number line, then 15 minutes of partner work matching fraction cards, and ends with a 10 minute exit ticket. I added a version of the card set for students who need more support, plus a challenge extension with improper fractions, and a printable answer key for the exit ticket.
title: Equivalent fractions lesson plan

opening: my tomato plants have yellow leaves on the bottom, is it too much water or something else
reply: Based on the photos, it's early blight rather than overwatering. The yellow leaves have brown spots with rings, and they're spreading upward from the soil line. I'd remove the affected lower leaves now, mulch so soil doesn't splash onto the plants, and water at the base in the morning. The Roma plants look worse than the cherry tomatoes, so I'd check those every couple of days. Next year, rotating the bed's location will help a lot.
title: Yellowing tomato leaves
